incident-bot: PAGING: routing-service error spike (route-fallback) — 503s increasing, auto-escalation to #incidents. Alert window: 3m

sara (oncall): seeing a lot of 503s and rapid model-switch logs. Rolling fallback to variant `beta-v2` in us-west and eu-central. customers complaining about malformed outputs.

mike (infra): can you paste the log lines? I want to see the policy decision path.

sara (oncall): logs: `route_decision: policy=v2-migration, field=route.default_variant (deprecated) present -> choose beta-v2` then `fallback: region=eu-central -> spinup-beta` repeated. attaching a snippet:```json
{"req_id":"r-9a3","policy":"v2-migration","field_used":"route.default_variant","chosen_variant":"beta-v2","fallback_count":6}```

owen (ml): who rolled the schema migration? that deprecated field should have been ignored. this looks like the new parser is treating the deprecated field as authoritative.

anya (product): we merged the config schema change in last night's deploy (PR #4521) to support explicit defaults, but the migration included a compatibility flag. might be related.

jack (support): support queue: ~42 customers reporting generation errors, mostly short/garbled responses. volume peaked ~8:32 UTC.

mike (infra): immediate mitigation: block the deprecated field at the router level and force default variant to `primary`. I can push a hotfix to routing policy enforcement.

sara (oncall): +1 to blocking. can you push a policy override? my pager is still loud.

mike (infra): running command now:```bash
rictl routing override set --policy v2-migration --field-guard route.default_variant --action ignore
rictl routing override set --policy v2-migration --default-variant primary
```

mike (infra): pushed. routing service reports policy reload succeeded. observing traffic: fallback loops dropping from 6/min to 0-1/min. error-rate starting to fall.

owen (ml): quick check: variant `beta-v2` had a different tokenizer mapping causing malformed outputs - that explains customer reports. good catch.

anya (product): do we need a rollback of last night's schema PR? or can we ship a validation patch to prevent deprecated fields being honored?

mike (infra): short-term no rollback needed; we blocked the field. long-term we should revert the parser change or add strict validation.

sara (oncall): handoff: I'm going to page on-call infra to stay with this for 30m, then hand back to platform rotation. mike will be owner for mitigation until stable.

jack (support): sent an update to impacted customers: "We're aware of generation issues and have applied emergency mitigations; engineers are monitoring. Expect updates in 30m."

lee (eng-man): quick customer impact note for the postmortem: 42 customers affected, peak 12% error rate for generation endpoints in EU/US regions, no PII exposure reported. assign postmortem owner: owen.

owen (ml): assigning myself. immediate items: 1) add validation to config parser to reject deprecated write-through fields 2) add unit tests for default semantics 3) coordinate a small rollback PR for the migration change if tests fail.

anya (product): also add a product note for enterprise customers about config schema changes and provide a migration guide. some customers had custom config that used the deprecated field.

mike (infra): monitoring: set alerts for fallback_count > 3/min and policy.field_used != null. added temporary dashboard.

sara (oncall): current status: mitigated (field blocked), errors trending down, support notified, infra monitoring. leaving the channel soon, handoff to mike for 30m.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status=mitigated, severity=high->medium, duration so far ~18m.

jack (support): will update the support thread in 15m with current status.

mike (infra): documenting commands used in runbook:```text
# emergency steps
1) block deprecated field: rictl routing override set --field-guard route.default_variant --action ignore
2) set explicit default: rictl routing override set --default-variant primary
3) monitor policy decisions: rictl routing trace --policy v2-migration --since 10m
```

owen (ml): postmortem scope: root cause = schema parser change honoring deprecated `route.default_variant` during migration; contributing = lack of validation and missing canary for policy default semantics. remediation = revert parser, add validation, and add canary traffic test for routing-compat.

anya (product): scheduling postmortem sync at 11:00 UTC today — invite engineers, product, support.

sara (oncall): last note before handoff: if errors rise again, page infra, tag `#incidents` and include `route.default_variant` in logs. handing off now. :thumbsup:

mike (infra): taking over monitoring. will post a final update in 30m.

incident-bot: INCIDENT FINAL: status=investigating->resolved pending postmortem, ended at 3267890300
